import "timezone"

option location = timezone.location(name: "Europe/Berlin")
from(bucket: "nexa")
  |> range(start: today())
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "nexa" and (r._field == "ppv" or r._field == "pac" or r._field == "totalBatteryPackChargingPower" or r._field == "totalBatteryPackChargingStatus"))

    })
  |> integral(unit: 1h)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: r._value / 1000.0 }))
  |> keep(columns: ["_value"])
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "Direkt ins Haus"})
